remarks: Experience waterfront living at Marina Bay, overlooking Long Island Sound! Spend your summer days lounging by the pool, watching boats glide by, or soaking up the sun at the private beach. This first floor one-level unit offers an easy flow from living room with working fireplace to the kitchen with laundry closet and opens to the dining room. There are two spacious bedrooms with ample closet space as well as two full bathrooms.  A charming patio overlooks the expansive grounds. One reserved parking space is included with plenty of additional spaces available. Embrace the Shippan community around you with the beach, tennis courts, baseball fields, restaurants, grocery shopping, and Metro North transportation all nearby. Enjoy the convenience yet with a quiet, peaceful, waterfront lifestyle!
